items.text: Raymond James states that, rather than leading with the highest check, it seeks competitive economics but leads with culture and capabilities as its differentiated value proposition.
items.quote: we don't lead with the highest check. We want to have competitive economics. Certainly, we have to have competitive economics, but we lead with culture and capabilities.

items.text: Raymond James says it has always been disciplined on transition assistance and economics to advisors.
items.quote: We remain disciplined. We've always been disciplined on those transaction assistance -- transition assistance and economics to advisers.

items.text: Raymond James says recruiting or acquisitions must meet three criteria: first a good cultural fit, then a good strategic fit, and finally a valuation that makes sense.
items.quote: It has to meet our three criteria, first being a good cultural fit... If it's a good cultural fit, then it has to be a good strategic fit... Finally, if those first two boxes are checked, then the valuation has to make sense for us

items.text: Raymond James says it would rather recruit advisors one by one than do acquisitions, because 100% of the transition assistance it pays goes to retention rather than to a seller.
items.quote: we'd much rather recruit one by one, where we know the advisors are a good cultural fit, and 100% of what we pay in transition assistance is going to retention versus the seller.

items.text: Raymond James states the most important thing it can do to grow the firm is to have high retention of its existing advisors and make sure they are satisfied.
items.quote: the most important thing we can do to grow the firm is have high retention of our existing advisers and making sure that our advisers are satisfied

items.text: Raymond James reports a 97% advisor satisfaction rate from its surveys, which it describes as the best it knows of in the industry.
items.quote: we have 97% adviser satisfaction rate, 97% adviser satisfaction rate with our surveys, which is the best I know of in the industry

items.text: Raymond James offers multiple affiliation options through AdvisorChoice, including traditional employee, advisor select, independent contractor, bank & credit union, and corporate RIA.
items.quote: Through AdvisorChoice®, you have the ability to match your professional goals to the affiliation option that's right for you... Traditional Employee... Advisor Select... Independent Contractor... Bank & Credit Union... Corporate RIA

items.text: Raymond James describes recruiting as a marathon, not a sprint, and says it is not something that can be turned on or off quarter to quarter; consistency is critical.
items.quote: It's a marathon, not a sprint... if you dial up recruiting quarter by quarter or dial it down quarter by quarter, then you're not gonna get the quality advisors that you want.

items.text: Raymond James contrasts its long-term, culture-and-platform approach with competitors it says compete with the largest check and change compensation plans yearly to cross-sell bank products.
items.quote: whereas many of our competitors compete with the largest check... whereas many of our competitors change their comp plans every year to cross-sell more bank products.

items.text: Raymond James participates, with limited exceptions, in the Protocol for Broker Recruiting, which governs the client information advisors may take when affiliating with a new firm and their ability to solicit prior-firm clients.
items.quote: We participate, with limited exceptions, in the Protocol for Broker Recruiting ("Protocol"), a voluntary agreement among many firms in the industry

items.text: Raymond James defines PCG recruiting and retention-related compensation as expenses related to cash and equity awards issued for recruiting activities, as retention for existing advisors, or with acquisitions, expensed over a 5-to-10-year service period.
items.quote: PCG recruiting and retention-related compensation includes expenses related to cash and equity awards issued in conjunction with recruiting activities, as retention for existing advisors, or in conjunction with our acquisitions
items.definition: cash and equity awards issued in conjunction with recruiting activities, as retention for existing advisors, or in conjunction with our acquisitions
